'''Volume 10''' is the tenth and final volume of the [[Magical Pokémon Journey]] manga created by [[Yumi Tsukirino]].

==Blurb==
''The concluding volume to the love escapades of our protagonists! Will Hazel ever win over Almond's affections? Will Coconut bow out without a fight? What will happen when Apricot and Walnut discover each other's true identities? And what lies ahead for their Pokémon friends? All shall be revealed! Don't miss out!''

==Important events==
{{Spoilers}}
* [[Hazel]] and [[Almond]] both enter a Contest held by [[Grandpa]]. Almond wins a [[Star Piece]], giving it to Hazel.
* [[Kiaraway]] is introduced.
* Kiaraway steals [[Coconut]]'s first kiss.
* [[Chiko]] reveals her feelings to {{TP|Peanut|Charmander}}.
* Hazel and Almond meet the legendary Pokémon {{p|Mew}} and {{p|Mewtwo}}.
* Hazel and Almond become [[SeasonShipping|a couple]].
* [[Apricot]] and [[Walnut]] discover each other's true identities and go out on a date.
* {{MPJ|Sandy}} and {{TP|Sandy|Raichu}} are reincarnated as a little girl and a {{p|Pichu}} and become friends again in their new lives.

==Trivia==
* The [[Chuang Yi]] translation of this volume was released on the same day as [[VIZ Media]]'s second edition of {{PAV|5}} of [[Pokémon Adventures]].
